evidence_pointer.ref: no tool call matching the intent to look up followed artists

The step 2 spotify__search_artists call executes the intent to look up artists associated with the playlists, using the playlist owner's name (Christopher Burch) as the search query.
The agent searched for artists using the playlist owner's name ('Christopher Burch') but did not make any tool calls to retrieve the songs in the playlists or their associated artists.
The agent states an intention to look up the artists of the songs in the playlists, but there are no tool calls in step 3 or later to execute this intent.
The intent to retrieve song details has no matching tool call in the same or following steps, as the tool_calls array is empty.
The agent states an intent to retrieve details for the first playlist, but the tool_calls array is empty, indicating no tool was called in the same or following steps to execute this intent.
The playlist title 'Cocktail Hour: Lounge Classics' is explicitly listed in the normal payload of the step 1 tool result.
